title: InsurancePolicy
description: A standalone insurance policy entity — life, home, health, motor, travel, pet, or professional indemnity. Life insurance is often the single largest estate asset. Policies written in trust pass outside the estate

id.description: Unique identifier for this insurance policy within the INHERIT document

policyType.$comment: life: life insurance (term, whole life, endowment). home: buildings and contents insurance. health: private medical or health insurance. motor: car, motorcycle, or vehicle insurance. travel: travel insurance policy. pet: pet insurance policy. professional_indemnity: professional indemnity or liability insurance. other: any other insurance type.

providerOrganisationId.description: Reference to the Organisation.id of the insurance provider

providerOrganisationIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced provider organisation

policyNumber.description: The insurance policy number or reference

coverAmount.description: Total cover amount (sum assured for life, rebuild cost for home, etc.) in minor currency units

premiumAmount.description: Premium amount per payment period, in minor currency units

premiumFrequency.$comment: monthly: paid every month. annual: paid once per year. single_premium: one-off payment. paid_up: no further premiums due. other: any other frequency.

renewalDate.description: Next renewal date. Important — cover may lapse if not renewed after death

maturityDate.description: Date the policy matures (for endowment policies and investment-linked policies)

deathBenefit.description: Death benefit details — what is payable on the policyholder's death, to whom, and how

amount.description: Death benefit amount in minor currency units

nomineePersonId.description: Reference to the Person.id of the nominated death benefit recipient

nomineePersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced nominee person

nomineeOrganisationId.description: Reference to the Organisation.id of the nominated death benefit recipient, if an organisation. Mutually exclusive with nomineePersonId

nomineeOrganisationIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced nominee organisation

nominationCurrent.description: Whether the death benefit nomination is believed to be current and valid

benefitType.description: How the death benefit is paid
benefitType.$comment: lump_sum: one-off payment. income: regular income payments. pension: pension benefit to dependant. discretionary: insurer or trustees decide.

beneficiaryVerificationStatus.description: Verification status of the death benefit beneficiary
beneficiaryVerificationStatus.$comment: AXA-requested: enables insurers to track beneficiary verification progress

writtenInTrust.description: Whether the policy is written in trust. If true, proceeds pass outside the estate and are not subject to inheritance tax

trustDetails.description: Details of the trust holding this policy, if writtenInTrust is true

trusteePersonId.description: Reference to the Person.id of the policy trustee

trusteePersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced trustee person

trusteeOrganisationId.description: Reference to the Organisation.id of a corporate trustee

trusteeOrganisationIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced trustee organisation

claimStatus.description: Current status of any claim against this policy
claimStatus.$comment: active: policy is active, no claim. claim_submitted: death benefit claim submitted to insurer. claim_approved: claim approved by insurer. claim_paid: claim paid out. claim_disputed: claim disputed — may be under investigation or legally contested. pending: legacy value — claim submitted, awaiting decision. approved: legacy value — claim approved. paid: legacy value — claim paid out. declined: claim declined by insurer.

externalPolicyRef.description: URI pointing to an external policy record (FHIR Coverage resource, or any external insurance management system)
externalPolicyRef.$comment: FHIR R5 Coverage resource reference. Generic — works with any insurance system.

nominationLifecycle.description: Lifecycle tracking for policy nominations — tracks the current nomination status and any superseding nominations
nominationLifecycle.$comment: CPF Board-requested: Central Provident Fund requires precise nomination tracking for death benefit distribution

verifiedAt.description: When the nomination was last verified as current

lastUpdated.description: When the nomination was last updated by the policyholder

supersedesNominationId.description: Reference to a previous nomination that this one replaces

policyConditions.description: Conditions, exclusions, or clauses that affect the policy — e.g. suicide clause, contestability period, pre-existing condition exclusions

condition.description: Description of the condition or clause

expiryDate.description: Date the condition expires, if applicable

impact.description: How this condition affects a claim
examples: Claim void if death by suicide within 2 years of policy start

notes.description: Free-text notes about this insurance policy
examples: Policy written in trust — proceeds bypass probate
Contact Sarah at Legal & General for claims: 0800 123 456

funeralPlanDetails.description: Details specific to funeral plan insurance

coveredFuneralProviderOrganisationId.description: Reference to the Organisation.id of the covered funeral provider

coveredFuneralProviderOrganisationIdDisp.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced covered funeral provider organisation

transferableOnDeath.description: Whether the plan is transferable on death

depositorProtection.description: Financial compensation scheme protection status. In the UK, the FSCS protects insurance policyholders if the insurer fails. Knowing whether a policy is protected matters for estate risk assessment

retrievedAt.description: When this protection status was checked

scheme.$comment: fscs: Financial Services Compensation Scheme (UK). mib: Motor Insurers' Bureau (UK, compulsory motor insurance guarantee)

protected.description: Whether this policy is protected by the scheme

protectionLimit.description: Maximum protection amount in minor units (pennies). FSCS insurance limit is unlimited for compulsory insurance, £85,000 for non-compulsory

claimProcessUrl.description: URL to the scheme's claim process or guidance page

provenance.description: Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it
